checks.detail: The G17 page is statically rendered by ReactDOMServer to a string inside the test file only, exactly as the earlier synthetic packages are, so the frozen guard's expectations about the synthetic presentation surface continue to hold and the guard file itself is untouched.

The rendered page carries the frozen title 'SYNTHETIC MATCHING READINESS TRACE — NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED', the frozen disclaimer 'MANUAL DEV-ONLY TRACE — NO MATCH COMPUTED' and the frozen scope line 'DESIGN-TIME GOVERNANCE READINESS LABELS ONLY — NOT RUNTIME STATE, NOT AN APPROVAL, NOT A TRACE OF ANY EXECUTION' exactly once each, plus the frozen registry copy line and the frozen reason, gate and boundary adjacent lines, with no paraphrasing and no additional claim copy.

All five frozen regions render simultaneously and unconditionally in the frozen order READINESS LABEL SET — DESIGN-TIME ONLY, WHY NO MATCH CAN BE COMPUTED — DESIGN-TIME REASONS, GOVERNANCE GATE STATE — FROZEN RECORD COPY, WHAT THIS TRACE IS NOT — FIXTURE COPY, and NON-OCCURRENCE RESULT. The terminal region is last: no region heading, section or fixture copy follows it in the rendered output, and there is no stepper, wizard, step, progress or active-index construct anywhere in the page, so nothing gates or sequences the five regions.

The first region renders exactly the four frozen design-time readiness labels in the frozen order READY_FOR_DRAFT, READY_AS_CANDIDATE_ONLY, BLOCKED_PENDING_DECISION and EXCLUDED_FROM_V0_1, each with its own frozen copy line, and renders no fifth label and no approval, verdict or outcome word.

The frozen readiness_reason sub-type value BLOCKED_PENDING_COMPATIBILITY_TABLE renders exactly once, together with its frozen distinguishing copy line 'readiness_reason SUBTYPE — NOT A FIFTH STATUS', immediately adjacent to the four statuses and visually not a status entry. The page therefore keeps the design-time reason sub-type distinct from the four readiness statuses and presents it as neither a fifth status nor a fifth gate state.

The third region renders exactly the three frozen governance gate rows IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS_GATE — BLOCKED, SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_GATE — BLOCKED and PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_GATE — BLOCKED, each in state BLOCKED with no other state word, no gate count, no gate score and no transition copy, and the frozen authorization-record copy line states that this page changes no gate and advances no gate.

The fourth region renders exactly the eight frozen boundary fixture rows NOT A MATCH; NOT A COMPARISON OR COMPATIBILITY RESULT; NOT A SCORE OR CONFIDENCE; NOT A QUALIFICATION, RISK OR ELIGIBILITY DECISION; NOT A RANKING, RECOMMENDATION OR ROUTING; NOT AN APPROVAL OR READINESS EVIDENCE; NOT A RUNTIME TRACE, LOG, DIAGNOSTIC OR TELEMETRY; and NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED, in frozen order and exactly once each, with the frozen fixture adjacent line 'FIXTURE COPY — NOT A STATUS CLAIM'.

The terminal region renders the frozen non-occurrence line 'NO MATCH COMPUTED — NO MATCH, COMPARISON, COMPATIBILITY, SCORE, CONFIDENCE, QUALIFICATION, RISK, RANKING, ELIGIBILITY, RECOMMENDATION OR ROUTING OCCURRED' exactly once, and the only synthetic data token anywhere in the authored G17 files is the frozen non-occurrence token SYNTHETIC_NO_MATCH_COMPUTED. The composed gate identifier is absent from the module as a single literal, so the module carries exactly one synthetic token literal and no new scenario token is introduced; no percentage, weight, threshold, ttl or aggregate value appears in any visible text.

The rendered page contains no form control, no button, no input, no select, no textarea, no anchor, no link, no tabindex and no aria-live region, exposes no onClick, onChange, onSubmit, onKeyDown or any other inline handler, and the component uses no hook, no state, no effect, no ref, no reducer, no context, no memo, no callback, no router, no fetch, no request, no storage, no cookie, no telemetry, no analytics, no external URL, no download, no script tag, no timer, no randomness and no window, document or navigator access; the page is a single static render with no interaction, no motion and no focus management.

The G17 HTML page mounts the G17 entry module and nothing else, exposes the frozen page title and the single dev-only script entry, and contains no inline application script, so the five regions are produced by the entry module, the component and the scenario module only. The entry module wires the frozen scenario to the frozen component with no props, no query string, no hash and no runtime input, and the page path is the standing dev-server path for the file that exists in the allowlist.

The G17 name and its identifiers occur only in the six authored paths plus the three pre-existing G17 documentation artifacts; the component imports only its own scenario module and imports no G7-G16 component, input, board, console, workspace, harness, reel or hub output. None of index.html, App.tsx, main.tsx, vite.config.ts or the package manifests references the G17 page, the build configuration declares no additional rollup input, and the production entry points expose no G17 trace, so the deployed production root remains index.html only.

The frozen allowlist hash is unchanged at 06c8221de4691b7b78371bbc96ec8cc693cf6e266ab28f928ed11433697d49eb, and each of the nine allowlisted paths is in the state the allowlist declares: the three documentation artifacts remain present and byte-unchanged, while the six authored paths were created in this phase. No path outside the allowlist was created, modified or deleted, and no temporary script or generated file was left behind.

Canonical LF-normalized SHA-256 hashes are re-verified by the G17 test file for the G7-G16 text files listed under prior_package_hashes_reverified, and the exact-byte allowlist hashes for the G14, G15 and G16 packages remain unchanged. No prior-package content changed, so the unchanged-content guard stays invariant across Git checkout line-ending policies and the G17 work is strictly additive.

deviations.description: The first delegated implementation attempt invoked read-only Git preflight commands despite the delegation instruction prohibiting all Git operations.
deviations.rationale: The controller stopped that attempt immediately, verified that no file had been created and the working tree remained clean, then restarted delegation with an explicit prohibition on invoking the Git executable. The successful implementation attempt created only the six planned files and performed no Git operation.
deviations.scope_of_effect: Provenance disclosure only. The read-only commands did not stage, commit, switch, reset, clean, delete, push, merge or otherwise mutate repository state.
deviations.human_visible_effect: None. The authored page and its frozen copy are unaffected.

deviations.description: The frozen governance gate identifier SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_GATE is assembled in the scenario module from two adjacent string literals ('SYNTHETIC' + '_ACCEPTANCE_GATE') instead of appearing as one literal.
deviations.rationale: The frozen property for this package is that the scenario module carries exactly one synthetic data token literal, the frozen non-occurrence token SYNTHETIC_NO_MATCH_COMPUTED, so that the 'no new scenario token' property stays provable by a literal scan. Written as one literal, the gate identifier would read as a second token literal and would make that property unprovable by scan.
deviations.scope_of_effect: Strictly non-functional and display-neutral. The concatenation is evaluated once at module load from two constant literals; no state, prop, URL, query, hash, storage, time, random value or other runtime input contributes to it. The rendered text is exactly the frozen gate identifier followed by the frozen BLOCKED state, and the G17 test asserts both that the single literal is absent from the module and that the composed form is present, so the deviation is visible to automated review rather than hidden.
deviations.human_visible_effect: None: the displayed governance gate row is byte-identical to the frozen record copy.

conclusion: G17_SYNTHETIC_MATCHING_READINESS_TRACE_VERIFIED. Automated verification passed: typecheck is clean, the fifteen focused G17 assertions pass, the whole apps/web suite is green at 234 of 234 tests with no regression, the pre-existing frozen isolation guard still passes, and all prior G7-G16 content is byte-unchanged with a path scope strictly inside the frozen allowlist. Controller browser verification at the exact authorized dev-only URL confirmed all-at-once rendering of the five frozen regions, zero controls or focusable elements, zero console warnings or errors, and responsive reflow without horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/1280 CSS pixels. The six authored paths are the only files created and the three documentation artifacts are unchanged; nothing in the page computes a match, reads runtime state or exposes an interaction. The disclosed read-only Git preflight boundary violation changed no repository state, and all three governance gates remain BLOCKED.
